CLEVELAND CAVALIERS 2025-26 PLAYER PAGES
02/24/26 VS. NEW YORK
#30 Darius Brown
Guard • 6-2 • 192lbs • 07/28/1999 • Utah State/USA
Rookie
PERSONAL: Son of Darius Sr. and Leah Brown... Has two brothers, Davian and Drew... Earned a bachelor's degree in communications from CSUN...
NOTES:
2025-26 Notes:
• Made his NBA debut on Feb. 24 vs. the Knicks.
• Signed a Two-Way contract with the Cavaliers on Feb. 20th.
• Prior to signing his Two-Way with the Cavaliers, Brown appeared in 34 games (30 starts) with the Cleveland Charge in the NBA G League, averaging 12.4 PPG, 9.7 APG, 3.8 RPG and 2.2 SPG in 33.5 MPG.
• On Jan. 9th vs. Texas Legends, Brown broke the Cleveland Charge record for assists in a game with 22 and was one AST shy of tying the G League's all-time of 23.
